parsed.rationale: Both participating records are test/mock fixtures. The first record resides in 'Shared/PartyHorn/Tests/PartyHornTests/SoundPlayerTests.swift' (a test file) and the second in 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift' (explicitly under a Mocks directory). Both carry the structural signal of being mock or test infrastructure. Consolidating these would couple two separate test packages (PartyHorn and Playback) through shared mock infrastructure, which risks introducing unintended test-scope dependencies. No production code is involved, so no refactor is warranted.
